text.body:
Ḍākiṇīvajrapañjaraṭippati (anonymous)
Kaiser Library 230 = NGMPP C 26/3
ff. 8, 56.5 x 5.5 `Gomola' script (from Vikramaśīla)
[1v] @ namo vajraḍākāya ||
praṇamya ḍākiṇīvajrapañjaraṃ yasya likhyate |
vibhāgo gurutaḥ samyaksmṛtaye 'nyasya kasyacit ||
*ākāśeṣu jaḍe svacche 'navakāśe prakāśini |
*viśve vajrālaye layane sattvadhātau manorame ||
,NAM MKHA' BEM BCAS DANG BA DANG,
,GO SKABS MED DANG 'BYED PA DANG,
,SNA tshOGS RDO RJE'I GZHI GNAS KHANG,
,SEMS CAN KHAMS DANG YID 'ONG DANG, 1.1
ākāśeṣv ityādi— ākāśaṃ dharmodayaḥ |
jaḍa iti pṛthvī |
svaccha iti vāruṇaṃ |
anavakāśa iti vāyuḥ |
prakāsinīti vahniḥ |
viśva iti dharmodayāntargataviśvapadmaṃ | vajrālaya iti | viśvapadmopari viśvavajraṃ |
layana iti candramaṇḍaloparidṛṣṭabhrūṃcakrasambhavavairocanasamāpattijanitāmṛtadhārādrutacaturmahābhūtapariṇāmitakūṭāgāraṃ | sattvadhātāv iti | tad eva ḍākaḍākinīnām ādhāratvāt sattvadhātuḥ |
tathā pañcaratnamayatvāt manoramaṃ |
etad uktaṃ bhavati | dharmodayāntargatakūṭāgāre | sthita iti pareṇa saṃbandhaḥ (see 8a) |
*sattve ca bhājane loke bhūrbhuvaḥsvarantare |
*manasi vigrahe vāci ekasmin dve ca khe ratau ||
,SEMS CAN SNOD DANG 'JIG RTEN DANG,
,SA DANG SA 'OG PAR SNANG DANG,
,YID DANG LUS DANG NGAG DANG NI,
,GCIG DANG GNYIS DANG MKHA' BDE DANG, 1.2
mahāsukhasvabhāvatayā vyāpitvena sattvāsattveṣv api sthita ity āha (see 8a) | sattve vetyādi |
sa iti caleṣu |
bhājana iti sthireṣu |
loka iti | etayor eva viśeṣaṇaṃ |
sattvaṃ nirdeśann āha | bhūr ityādi |
yathākramaṃ svargamartyapātālastheṣu |
antara iti eṣv eva bhājanād anyeṣu |
manasītyādi | eṣām eva manaḥkāyavāksu |
ekasminn iti [|] eṣām eva viśuddhe rūpe mahāsukhasvabhāve grāhakākāre |
dve cetyādi | prajñopāyātmake | śūnyatākaruṇābhinnabodhicitte |
khe ratāv iti | śūnyatāsvabhāve grāhyāṃśe |
*ṣaṭke pañcasu dviṣaṭkeṣu caturṣu jagatsu api |
*traidhātuka-m-aśeṣeṣu ekonaviṃśatsv api ||
,DRUG DANG LNGA DANG DRUG GNYIS DANG,
,BZHI DANG SKYE 'GRO RNAMS DANG NI,
,GCIG GIS NYI SHUR MA tshANG DANG,
,KHAMS GSUM MA LUS PA DANG NI, 1.3
ṣaṭkheti (!) | rūpādyāyatanaṣaṭke |
pañcasv iti | skandhapañcake |
dviṣaṭkeṣv iti | dvādaśasv āyataneṣu |
caturṣv iti mahābhūtacatuṣṭaye |
ekonaviṃśatye pīty atraiva yojyaṃ | pudgalasahiteṣv aṣṭādaśadhātuṣv iti bhāvaḥ |
tato bhājanasya nirdeśaḥ | jagatsv iti |
asyaiva pratinirdeśaḥ | traidhātukam aśeṣeṣv iti |
*pitari putre mātṛṣu bāhyābhyantaram eva ca |
*sarvayoṣitsu dharme ca sarvakarmasu cānātmani ||
,PHA DANG BU DANG MA MO DANG,
,PHYI ROL DANG NI NANG DANG 'AM,
,BtsUN MO KUN DANG CHOS DANG NI,
,THAMS CAD LAS DANG BDAG MED DANG, 1.4
pitarītyādi caturṣv ity anantaraṃ yojyaṃ | lokaprasiddheṣv eva pitrādiṣv ity arthaḥ |
bāhyetyādi | bāhyābhyantaravyapadeśena sattvāsattvam eva nirdeśati |
sarvayoṣitsv iti | sarvavidyānāṃ sukhādhāratvāt | tatra sthita iti bhāvaḥ |
dharme ceti nīlapītādike |
sarvakarmasu ceti | eṣām eva nīlādīnāṃ rañjanādikriyālakṣaṇe |
anātmanīti | prākṛtātmabhāvaśūnyadevatādehe |
*phale hetau kāryākhye sādhye sādhanavajriṇi |
*tathā hy ālayavijñāne dharmadhātāv anudbhave ||
,'BRAS BU RGYU DANG BYA BA ZHES;
;BSGRUB BYA SGRUB THABS RDO RJE DANG,
,DE BZHIN KUN GZHI RNAM SHES DANG,
,CHOS KYI DBYINGS DANG MA BYUNG DANG, 1.5
phala iti phalahevajre |
hetāv iti | hetuhevajre |
kāryākhya iti | etayor eva viśeṣaṇaṃ |
etāv evāha sādhye sādhanavajriṇīti |
atha vā sādhyaṃ mahāsukhaṃ | sādhanaṃ tasyaivopāyaḥ |
idānīm āṃbharaṃ (?) nirdiśan sādhyasyaivāvasthādvayaṃ samalanirmalātmakaṃ darśayitum āha– tathā hītyādi |
ālayavijñāne sarvavāsanānilayalakṣaṇe |
dharmadhātāv iti | anālayarūpatāṃ gate |
anudbhava iti | upādānacittakṣaṇād anyasmāt kāraṇād utpādarahite |
*sattvadhātau khadhātau cānātmani ātmasaṃjñini |
*vibhāveṣu anābhāve sukhāvatyāṃ trikoṇake ||
,NAM MKHA'I KHAMS DANG RANG DBYINGS DANG,
,BDAG MED PA DANG BDAG CES DANG,
,DNGOS PO MED DANG DNGOS MED MIN,
,BDE BA CAN DANG GRU GSUM DANG, 1.6
sattvadhātāv iti | sattvasya saṃbhogakāyākhyasya tadbījādhāratvād ādhāre |
khena śūnyatāṃśena sādhakānāṃ poṣaṇā[2r]t khadhātau ca |
grāhyagrāhakākārasvabhāvavivekād anātmani |
ubhayaviviktenātmanā sthitatvād ātmasaṃjñini |
anātmanīty asya nirdeśo vibhāveṣv atīti | vigatā grāhyādayo bhāvā asminn iti vibhāve | pūjārhatvād bahuvacanam |
ātmasaṃjñinīty asya nirdeśo 'nābhāva iti | grāhyagrāhakavigamarūpeṇa vidyamānatvān nābhāve |
sukhasya jñeyalakṣaṇasyāṅgasya rakṣaṇāt sukhāvatyāṃ |
trikoṇarūpamahīrūpatvena trikoṇake |
*araje vigatadoṣeṣu viraje gatakalmaṣe |
*nistaraṅge samādhau antaḥsatsukhavedini ||
,AA SKYES DANG NI SKYON BRAL DANG,
,RDUL BRAL DANG NI SDIG BCOM DANG,
,DBA' RLABS MED @379B PA'I RANG BZHIN DANG,
,MTHAR NI ZHI BA'I BDE RIG DANG, 1.7
rāgādīnāṃ tatrābhāvād araje |
asyaiva nirdeśapratinirdeśatatpratinirdeśāḥ | vigatadoṣeṣv ityevamādīni vacanāni |
sarvavikalparahitatvān nistaraṅge |
samādhiś cittaikāgratā tadātmakatvāt samādhau |
grāhyāṃśasukhavedanātmakatvād antaḥsatsukhavedini |
*rahasye parame ramye sarvātmani sadā sthitaḥ |
*sarvabuddhamayaḥ sattvo ḍākinīvajrapañjaraḥ ||
,GSANG DANG MCHOG DANG DGYES PA LA,
...? [see below 1.9c!]
,SANGS RGYAS KUN KHYAB SEMS DPA' NI,
,MKHA' 'GRO MA YI RDO RJE GUR, 1.8
apātrabhūteṣu gopyatvād rahasye |
utkṛṣṭatvāt parame |
ramaṇīyatvād ramye |
sarveṣām ātmā'yam eveti sarvātmani |
sadeti | prabandhanityatvāt sarvakālaṃ |
sthita iti sambandhaḥ |
ko 'sāv ity āha— sarvabuddhamaya ityādi | sarvabuddhasvabhāvatvāt tanmayo mahāvajradhara ity arthaḥ |
ayaṃ ca sattvārthaṃ prati satatapravṛttatvāt sattvaḥ | ḍākinīnāṃ nairātmyādīnāṃ bahirgamananiṣedhakatvena vajrapañjaram iva vajrapañjaraḥ |
*asau svayambhūr bhagavān eka evādhidaivataḥ |
*pañcalakṣātmahevajrād uktavān pañca maṇḍalam ||
,'DI NI RANG BYUNG BCOM LDAN 'DAS;
;LHA YI BDAG PO GCIG PU NYID,

paramārthato hetvabhāvāt svayambhūḥ |
aiśvaryādiṣaḍguṇayogād bhagavān |
dharmakāyarūpatayā | eko 'dvitīyaḥ |
sambhoganirmāṇakāyasvabhāvatvād adhidaivataḥ |
uktavān iti sambandhaḥ |
